alex: quick FYI — invoice preview drift detected after routing policy rollout at 09:45. about 0.2% tokens attributed to fallback SKU.
mira: which policy? priority-v3?
sam: yes, we tightened proxy header normalization. looks like route_resolution_id missing for some sessions.
billing-bot: alert: preview delta 0.2% for 6 tenants. est ~$430 impact.
alex: mitigation: pause rollout, add preview fallback to consult session->route cache (TTL 3d), run targeted backfill for tenants with >30 nulls.
deploy-bot: rollback started for routing-priority v3 canary 10%->0%.
mira: I'll run detection query and enqueue backfill for >30 hits. sam: I'll add fallback write to route-cache when resolution occurs and emit metric ingest.route_resolution_lost.
billing-bot: backfill queued for 6 tenants.
alex: action items summarized in runbook -> /runbooks/routing-rollout-billing.md. sync in 45m.
